name: signin
title: Sign in
description: The helm mark builds itself, opens into the Google sign-in, and pressing it hands off to connecting accounts.

name: connect
title: Connect accounts
description: LinkedIn connects and its badge pops onto the diagram, a disconnect is taken back with Undo, then X connects too.

name: leads
title: Add leads
description: A CSV dropped in becomes rows in the sheet, one lead is removed, an Excel file adds more and Undo takes that file back.

name: team
title: Invite team
description: A pasted To: line turns into chips, one is removed, another is typed in, and Start begins the pilot.

name: pilot-launch
title: Pilot launch
description: On the pilot dashboard a demo is picked and published: night falls, fireworks, the card flips into a bottle that is corked and splashes out to sea, Sent, and the demo flies into the menu of the main dashboard.

name: storyboard
title: Storyboard editor
description: The storyboard editor: drag a shot into a new place, say a change to a line and read it before it applies, then cut a shot with Undo in its place.

name: edit-text
title: Edit text, Swap image and callouts
description: On the portfolio page in Edit text mode: a caption rewritten in place, a screen swapped from every saved iteration, and a new callout added where it's needed. None of it goes through a prompt.

name: storyboard-peek
title: Storyboard peek
description: Hovering a demo's name on the dashboard slides its storyboard in; moving to the next name changes the title first, then the old shots slide down and the new ones slide up.

name: dashboard
title: Main dashboard
description: The main dashboard: the Face & Voice card, the time range rolled from a month to six, Check-in expanded down to the drop-off, and a trigger swiped away and brought back with Undo.

name: dashboard-menu
title: Dashboard menu
description: The side menu walks through Approvals, Inbox, Strategy, Demos and Face & Voice, each opening in place inside the dashboard.

name: face-email
title: Face & Voice email
description: The email sent after onboarding: the same deep-tide Face & Voice card as the dashboard, a talking welcome in the porthole, and one Set up button.

name: phone
title: Dashboard on a phone
description: The same dashboard at phone width: Home scrolls past the Face & Voice card, Pipeline and Strategy, then the tab row at the top opens Strategy in place and goes back Home.
